definitions.explanation: Relating to matter, physics, or the physical world as opposed to mental, spiritual, or abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {物理的|ぶつりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{物理的|ぶつりてき}な⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: We can't meet because of the physical distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{物理的|ぶつりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I'm tired both mentally and physically.

notes:
USAGE: {物理的|ぶつりてき} is a ～⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ adjective often contrasted with ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧ (mental/spiritual).

FORMS:
- {物理的|ぶつりてき}な＋noun (physical ~)
- {物理的|ぶつりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (physically - adverbial form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物理的|ぶつりてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧ (physically impossible)
- {物理的|ぶつりてき}な⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ (physical distance)
- {物理的|ぶつりてき}な⟦{制約|せいやく}→制約：11811_seiyaku⟧ (physical constraints)
- {物理的|ぶつりてき}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧ (physical existence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧ - mental, spiritual
- ⟦{肉体的|にくたいてき}→肉体的：06198_nikutaiteki⟧ - bodily, physical (relating to the body)

NOTE: {物理的|ぶつりてき} focuses on physical laws and material reality, while ⟦{肉体的|にくたいてき}→肉体的：06198_nikutaiteki⟧ focuses specifically on the human body.
